problem.problem:
Bob is rough. Dave is furry. Dave is nice. Dave is not red. Dave is smart. Fiona is green. Fiona is nice. Harry is blue. Harry is furry. Harry is green. Harry is nice. Harry is not red. Harry is rough. Harry is smart. Smart things are green. If something is nice and not rough then it is red. If something is nice then it is smart. If something is rough then it is nice. If something is blue then it is furry. All blue, smart things are furry. If Bob is furry and Bob is not rough then Bob is green. If something is green then it is blue. If something is red and not nice then it is not blue.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Bob is not green.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?

Facts:
Rough(Bob, True) ::: Bob is rough.
Furry(Dave, True) ::: Dave is furry.
Nice(Dave, True) ::: Dave is nice.
Red(Dave, False) ::: Dave is not red.
Smart(Dave, True) ::: Dave is smart.
Green(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is green.
Nice(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is nice.
Blue(Harry, True) ::: Harry is blue.
Furry(Harry, True) ::: Harry is furry.
Green(Harry, True) ::: Harry is green.
Nice(Harry, True) ::: Harry is nice.
Red(Harry, False) ::: Harry is not red.
Rough(Harry, True) ::: Harry is rough.
Smart(Harry, True) ::: Harry is smart.

Rules:
Smart($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: Smart things are green.
Nice($x, True) && Rough($x, False) >>> Red($x, True) ::: If something is nice and not rough then it is red.
Nice($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: If something is nice then it is smart.
Rough($x, True) >>> Nice($x, True) ::: If something is rough then it is nice.
Blue($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: If something is blue then it is furry.
Blue($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: All blue, smart things are furry.
Furry(Bob, True) && Rough(Bob, False) >>> Green(Bob, True) ::: If Bob is furry and Bob is not rough then Bob is green.
Green($x, True) >>> Blue($x, True) ::: If something is green then it is blue.
Red($x, True) && Nice($x, False) >>> Blue($x, False) ::: If something is red and not nice then it is not blue.

Query:
Green(Bob, False) ::: Bob is not green.
